## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
AGENTS.md still tells contributors to run `make test`, but this pull request removes that target. Fix this before merge because AGENTS.md says these commands are the only checks a change gets.

## Changes
The Makefile `test` target is renamed to `check`, and README.md now says `make check`. AGENTS.md gets a new Layout section that lists the repository's files and the Makefile targets.

## Important
- AGENTS.md:18 — comments — Change the AGENTS.md command to `make check` — A contributor who follows AGENTS.md:18, "Run `make test` before you push; it runs the pytest suite.", gets make's "No rule to make target 'test'" error, because this pull request renamed that target to `check` at Makefile:6. Your new Layout line at AGENTS.md:10 already names `check`, so the guide now contradicts itself. — AGENTS.md says the repository has no CI, so contributors and agents who follow the stale command push without running the pytest suite.
